metadata.question: Does the GERD reservoir (Ethiopia) water level decrease in February 2022 compared to September 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-1 SAR data (works day/night, through clouds) for water detection - GERD location: ~11.2°N, 35.1°E in Ethiopia - Time periods: September 2021 vs February 2022 - Water bodies show low backscatter in SAR (VV polarization) 2. Masking strategy: - Use VV polarization backscatter threshold to identify water pixels - Lower backscatter = water (typically < -15 dB) - Calculate water extent for both periods 3. Logic: - Valid water area calculation for both periods → A (decreased) or B (not decreased) - No images found → C1 - No valid pixels after processing → C2 - Invalid calculation result → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define GERD reservoir geometry const gerd = ee.Geometry.Point([35.09, 11.22]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around dam // 2. Time periods const sep2021Start = '2021-09-01'; const sep2021End = '2021-09-30'; const feb2022Start = '2022-02-01'; const feb2022End = '2022-02-28'; // 3. Load Sentinel-1 SAR data for September 2021 let col_sep = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(gerd) .filterDate(sep2021Start, sep2021End) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const size_sep = col_sep.size().getInfo(); console.log(`September 2021 Images: ${size_sep}`); if (size_sep === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-1 data for September 2021.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Load Sentinel-1 SAR data for February 2022 let col_feb = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(gerd) .filterDate(feb2022Start, feb2022End) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .select('VV'); const size_feb = col_feb.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2022 Images: ${size_feb}`); if (size_feb === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-1 data for February 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Create median composites const img_sep = col_sep.median(); const img_feb = col_feb.median(); // 6. Identify water pixels (VV < -15 dB indicates water) const water_sep = img_sep.lt(-15); const water_feb = img_feb.lt(-15); // 7. Calculate water area for September 2021 const stats_sep = water_sep.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: gerd, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels_sep = stats_sep.get('VV').getInfo(); if (waterPixels_sep === null || waterPixels_sep === undefined) { console.log('Failed to calculate September 2021 water area.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Calculate water area for February 2022 const stats_feb = water_feb.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: gerd, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels_feb = stats_feb.get('VV').getInfo(); if (waterPixels_feb === null || waterPixels_feb === undefined) { console.log('Failed to calculate February 2022 water area.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Check for valid pixels if (waterPixels_sep === 0 && waterPixels_feb === 0) { console.log('No valid water pixels detected in either period.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 10. Calculate actual areas (pixels * 1000m * 1000m / 1e6 for km²) const area_sep_km2 = (waterPixels_sep * 1.0); const area_feb_km2 = (waterPixels_feb * 1.0); console.log(`Sep 2021 Water Pixels: ${waterPixels_sep.toFixed(0)}`); console.log(`Feb 2022 Water Pixels: ${waterPixels_feb.toFixed(0)}`); console.log(`Sep 2021 Relative Area: ${area_sep_km2.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`Feb 2022 Relative Area: ${area_feb_km2.toFixed(1)}`); // 11. Compare water levels if (area_feb_km2 < area_sep_km2) { console.log('Water level DECREASED in February 2022.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water level did NOT decrease in February 2022.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
